description: Find Stockholm public transport (SL) stops by name and return their ids, names and transport modes. Use it to get the siteId for get_departures, or a stop id for plan_trip. Not for street addresses: pass those to plan_trip as text instead. A name can match several stops ('Arlanda' gives the train station and bus stops): pick by name and modes, or ask the user. Typos are fine, abbreviations are not: write 'Tekniska högskolan', not 'KTH'. Returns one line per stop: '<id>: <town>, <name> (<modes>)'.

limit.description: Maximum number of stops to return

query.description: Stop or station name, e.g. 'Slussen' or 'Arlanda'. Typos are fine, abbreviations are not.

name: find_stop
title: Find stop
